hook: Your road in Sweden used to run on the left.
title: Sweden Switched Road Sides in One Night
description:
On 3 September 1967, Sweden moved from driving on the left to driving on the right. The change is known as Dagen H. Almost all traffic stopped while the whole country made the switch.

Series: Places That Shouldn't Exist.

#Shorts #Sweden #Geography
comment_prompt: Would you have driven that day? Yes or no
